dialogue.content: 本日は相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。今から相談を始めますので、はじめに年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. We're about to begin, so could you please start by telling me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします30代女です
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'm a woman in my 30s.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。よろしくお願いいたします。お名前は何とお呼びしたら良いでしょうか？（ニックネームでも大丈夫ですよ）
dialogue.English: Thank you. It's nice to meet you. What would you like me to call you? (A nickname is fine, too.)

dialogue.content: 名前ですか、じゃあピーで
dialogue.English: My name? Well, then, just 'P'.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Please.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ピーさんですね今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. P, then. What brings you here for a consultation today?

dialogue.content: コロナ禍でにストレスがすごいです
dialogue.English: The stress from this whole COVID pandemic is just overwhelming.

dialogue.content: 自分だけの分だけでなく親の分も浴びせられていて辛いです
dialogue.English: It's not just my own stress, but I'm also being bombarded with my parent's stress, and it's painful.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それはお辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be really difficult for you.

dialogue.content: 内心、はやく死ねやと思ってしまうことがあり、それがつらいです
dialogue.English: Sometimes, deep down, I find myself thinking, 'I wish they would just hurry up and die,' and that feeling itself is painful.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…。ストレスもたまって、つらい気持ちもわいているんですね。親の分もということですが、今はどんな感じなんですか？
dialogue.English: I see... So you have this built-up stress, and these painful feelings are emerging. You mentioned your parent's share of the stress as well; could you tell me more about what that's like right now?

dialogue.content: 親が高齢者ですから家から出るのを我慢してるんですねそれは感謝してるんです
dialogue.English: My parent is elderly, so they're refraining from going out. I'm grateful for that.

dialogue.content: うちは家族に医療従事者が多いので家族から感染なんてできないものですから
dialogue.English: We have many healthcare workers in the family, so we can't risk infection from family members.

dialogue.content: けど、私だって仕事以外はあまり外出はしていません
dialogue.English: But I don't go out much either, except for work.

dialogue.content: しかし親はそれさえも羨ましく思うみたいで
dialogue.English: However, it seems my parent is even envious of that.

dialogue.content: こちらにあたってくるときがあり、しんどいのです
dialogue.English: There are times when they take it out on me, and it's exhausting.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。ピーさんもコロナで我慢したり、家族に気を使ったりしているのに・・、あたられてしまうのはしんどいですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Even though you're also making sacrifices due to COVID and being considerate of your family, P... it must be exhausting to have that taken out on you.

dialogue.content: なんかすごく攻撃的なんです家にいるからニュースやワイドショーをよく見ているようですがコロナや政治、小室さんの文書のことなどに対してすごく怒った意見を言ってくるんです
dialogue.English: They've become very aggressive. Since they're home all the time, they seem to watch a lot of news and talk shows, and they'll come at me with these really angry opinions about COVID, politics, or the Komuro documents.

dialogue.content: そういった意見って賛同する内容でもあまりに攻撃的に言われると心が疲弊してくるといいますか
dialogue.English: Even if I agree with their opinions, when they're expressed so aggressively, it just wears me down mentally, you know?

dialogue.content: もう黙れよって思ってしまうんですよね
dialogue.English: I end up thinking, 'Just shut up already.'

dialogue.content: それはしんどいですね。。そう思われるのも無理ないと思います。ちなみに、そのご家族はどなたでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That sounds exhausting... I think it's completely understandable that you'd feel that way. By the way, which family member are you referring to?

dialogue.content: 母です父は少し前に亡くなっているので、ますます同世代のお話とかができないのも原因だと思います
dialogue.English: It's my mother. My father passed away a little while ago, so I think part of the reason is that she can no longer talk with people from her own generation.

dialogue.content: 母が今、なんの遠慮もなく話せるのは私だけというのもわかっているんですけど
dialogue.English: I also understand that I’m the only one my mother can talk to without holding back right now.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。ピーさんが、お母さんのこと心配されてる気持ちも伝わってきました。
dialogue.English: I see. I can also sense that you're worried about your mother, P.

dialogue.content: そうですね、大切に育ててもらった自覚はあるので私も大切にしたいです
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm aware that she raised me with great care, so I want to cherish her as well.

dialogue.content: 怒られたりされながらも、お母さんのことを大切にされているんですね。
dialogue.English: So even while she gets angry with you, you still cherish your mother.

dialogue.content: それと同時に、コロナ禍でのストレスもあってイライラしてしまう気持ちもあるんですね。
dialogue.English: And at the same time, with the stress of the pandemic, you also feel irritable.

dialogue.content: 普段はむしろ子煩悩な母なんですそんな母にいくらなんか言われているにしても優しくできない自分も嫌ですね
dialogue.English: Usually, she's actually a doting mother. I hate that I can't be kind to her, no matter what she says to me.

dialogue.content: けど、意見を聞き流せないので反応すると冷たい反応でびっくりしたとか言われるんですね
dialogue.English: But I can't just let her comments slide, so when I react, she tells me she's surprised by how cold my response is.

dialogue.content: ふたりともイライラしているから悪循環なんでしょうね
dialogue.English: I guess it's a vicious cycle because we're both irritated.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。ストレスがたまると、ちょっとしたことでも疲れが出てしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That's right. When stress builds up, even small things can feel exhausting.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、いつ頃からそのような感じになってきたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, when did it start to feel like this?

dialogue.content: 今回のコロナの波の再発くらいですね
dialogue.English: Around the time of this latest COVID resurgence.

dialogue.content: もう収まると思っていたんじゃないでしょうか
dialogue.English: I think we thought it was finally settling down.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。もう収まると思っていたのに、また再発となると・・がっかりしてしまいますもんね。
dialogue.English: I see. To think it was almost over, only for it to surge again... that must be very disappointing.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、私もそうです笑
dialogue.English: Exactly, I feel the same way, haha.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。ちなみに再発前は、どんな感じだったんですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. What were things like before the resurgence?

dialogue.content: そろそろ、ここ（レストラン）行ってみたいなーとか
dialogue.English: We were able to say things like, 'I'd like to go to this restaurant soon...'

dialogue.content: 少しのんきなことも言えてましたね
dialogue.English: We could talk about more lighthearted things.

dialogue.content: おでかけ（レストラン）素敵ですね。ピーさんとお母さんの仲の良さが伝わってきました
dialogue.English: Going out to a restaurant sounds lovely. I can sense the closeness between you and your mother.

dialogue.content: そうですね仲は良い方です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'd say we are close.

dialogue.content: いつも仲良くやっていたけど、今回のコロナ禍でお母さんのイライラがたまって、その怒りを受けるピーさんも疲れがたまってきて・・そんな悪循環になってる感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You've generally gotten along well, but with this pandemic your mother’s frustration has built up. Taking the brunt of her anger has left you worn out too, and it feels like you’re both caught in a vicious cycle. Is that right?

dialogue.content: そうですねそれで言い返しての悪循環ですね
dialogue.English: Yes, and then I snap back, making it a vicious cycle.

dialogue.content: 年取ってきたせいか我慢が以前よりできなくなったように感じますね母
dialogue.English: I feel like my mother has become less patient than she used to be, maybe because she's getting older.

dialogue.content: もう聞きたくないんですよね
dialogue.English: I just don’t want to hear it anymore.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます、それはつらいですよね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. That must be very painful.

dialogue.content: はいつらいです
dialogue.English: Yes, it's painful.

dialogue.content: お母さんに冷たい対応してしまうのもつらいともおっしゃっていましたよね。
dialogue.English: You also mentioned it’s painful for you that you end up responding coldly to your mother.

dialogue.content: そうです、自分では冷たい対応してると思ってなかったので言われてびっくりしました
dialogue.English: That's right. I didn't think I was being cold, so I was surprised when she said that.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。そんなつもりじゃないのに、冷たいって言われたら悲しくなりますもんね。
dialogue.English: I can imagine. It must be sad to be told you're being cold when that wasn't your intention.

dialogue.content: まあうざいなとお思いながら対応してたんで気持ちが出ましたね多分
dialogue.English: Well, I was interacting with her while thinking 'this is so annoying,' so my feelings probably showed.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。ありがとうございます。ここで少しお話をまとめてみてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you. Would it be all right if I took a moment to summarize our conversation?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます、少しお時間いただきますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Please give me a moment.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: コロナ禍で外出できないストレスもあり、お母さんがピーさんにイライラをぶつけてくるようになりました。ピーさん自身も疲れがたまっていたものの、しっかり会話を受け止める努力をされていました。お母さん想いで、優しくとても誠実な方だと思います。でも、コロナの再発で先行きもわからない中で、お互いイライラがたまり悪循環になっているように思います。
dialogue.English: Due to the stress of not being able to go out during the pandemic, your mother started taking her frustrations out on you. Although you were also exhausted, P, you made an effort to listen to her properly. I think you are a very kind, sincere, and caring person who thinks deeply of your mother. However, with the resurgence of COVID and the uncertainty of the future, it seems you've both become irritated, leading to a vicious cycle.

dialogue.content: そう言ってもらると嬉しいです
dialogue.English: It makes me happy to hear you say that.

dialogue.content: お母さんへの想い、これからも大切にしてほしいなと思いました。ですので、この悪循環からどうやって抜け出したらよいか、一緒にお話ししたいと思うのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I hope you’ll continue to cherish your feelings for your mother. With that in mind, I’d like for us to talk together about how to break out of this vicious cycle. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: （お時間すぎてしまってすみません💦ここでいったん終了にしましょうか）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry, we've gone over our time. Shall we wrap up for today?)

dialogue.content: はーい！
dialogue.English: Okay!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！わかりやすくお話しいただけて、とてもありがたかったです。また機会がありましたら、ぜひよろしくお願いいたします（タイピングでお待たせしてしまってすみませんでした。）
dialogue.English: Thank you very much! I really appreciate how clearly you shared your experience. If there’s another opportunity, I’d be grateful to speak again. (I’m sorry to have kept you waiting with the typing.)

dialogue.content: いえいえこちらこそ誠実にお話聴いていただける感がすごくあってよかったです！また、よろしくお願いします！
dialogue.English: Not at all, thank you. I really felt that you listened to me with sincerity, which was wonderful! Yes, I look forward to speaking with you again!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！それでは失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Thank you! I'll sign off now.
